statements.t: Management intends to seek additional financing through equity issuances, debt arrangements, and other available sources of capital while continuing to generate revenue from its oil and gas production activities and managing operating expenditures.
These evaluations require management to make estimates regarding future production volumes, commodity prices, operating costs, remaining economic lives, and expected future cash flows.
Management also makes estimates related to the valuation of stock-based compensation, expected credit losses on accounts receivable, and asset retirement obligations, when applicable.

dropped.t: We will require additional funds to fund our budgeted expenses over the next twelve months.
There is still no assurance that we will be able to maintain operations at a level sufficient for an investor to obtain a return on his investment in our common stock.
